name: motif_edit_exception_features
description:
Set exception features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Use only if one stem, clitic or inflectional affix carries an arbitrary restriction; otherwise use an inflection class, or compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for derivation. Many stems: compose-tag-stems-by-query (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Sets the exact exception features a stem or clitic carries, or the ones an inflectional affix requires of its stem. An empty list clears the set. Derivational affixes use their own command. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-exception-features. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the grammatical info of a stem, clitic or inflectional affix entry.

exception_features.description: Exact set of exception feature ids; an empty list removes them all.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
